items:
Coconut Cove is an exquisite seven-bedroom vacation retreat in Seagrove, just steps from the beach, comfortably accommodating up to twenty-five guests. This beautifully designed property offers spacious bedrooms, a private pool, multiple balconies, and a charming southern-style front porch. Located just a short walk from the Gulf of Mexico and Seaside’s town center, Coconut Cove combines convenience with coastal luxury.

Inside, the home features stylish decor, rich hardwood floors, and modern appliances throughout. The main living area boasts a large white sectional, cozy fireplace, flatscreen TV, and sliding doors that open to the pool deck and outdoor dining space. Adjacent to the living room is a chef’s dream kitchen, complete with quartz countertops, a breakfast bar with seating for four, stainless steel appliances, and a double oven. The formal dining area seats up to eight and overlooks the pool, making it perfect for family gatherings. A full laundry room is also located on the first floor.

On the first floor, you’ll find two bedrooms. The master suite includes a king bed, flatscreen TV, and a spa-inspired bathroom with a dual-sink vanity, Roman bathtub, walk-in shower, walk-in closet, and private water closet. The second bedroom features a king bed, flatscreen TV, and an ensuite bathroom with a walk-in shower, accessible from the hallway.

The second floor includes four additional guest bedrooms, a cozy living area, and two balconies. The living space is furnished with a couch, armchair, flatscreen TV, and opens to a balcony with al fresco dining. A bunk room off the living area, featuring a twin/full bunk bed and flatscreen TV, is perfect for kids. Two guest rooms on this level include a king bed, flatscreen TV, and ensuite bathrooms with dual vanities; one has a walk-in shower, while the other has a shower/tub combo. The last guest room on this floor can sleep up to eight, with a king bed and full/full/full bunk bed, as well as a flatscreen TV and walk-in closet.

The third floor features the final bedroom, a full bathroom, and a game room. This last bedroom, ideal for kids, includes two queen beds and a flatscreen TV. The hallway bathroom has a walk-in shower. The game room offers bean bag seating, a sleeper sofa, card table, mini-fridge, flatscreen TV, and foosball table, making it a fun hangout space.

Outside, the pool deck is fully equipped for sunny days, with a private pool, outdoor fireplace, flatscreen TV, grill, al fresco dining, and bar seating, making it the ultimate setting for outdoor gatherings and relaxation.

Please note: Fireplaces are available seasonally, from October through April, and are not operational from May to September.

POOL HEAT
A $50.00 per day fee is added to reservations booked between October 1st - April 30th for Pool Heat. If you prefer to have an unheated pool, please email or call after booking and the fees will be immediately refunded.

BEACH ACCESS: This is about 150-200 yards directly south of Coconut Cove. You can find the "Dothan Public Beach Access" at
276 Montgomery Street in Seagrove Beach.

You will find everything you need in the property to make the most of your time on the Emerald Coast. We offer a starter kit of premium, eco-friendly guest amenities including: Shampoo, Conditioner, Body and Face Soap, Toilet Paper, Facial Tissues, Dish Soap, Dishwasher Pods, Laundry Detergent, Paper Towels, Trash Bags, Dish Sponge, Bath Towels, and Bed linens. We hope you choose this property, as we'll do all we can to make sure you have an amazing and memorable vacation here at Modern Beach Vacation Rentals!
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.text: We had a great Thanksgiving week stay. Our group of 10 adults, 5 children, and 1 dog all had fun. The pool was lovely and warm, the kitchen was well stocked with equipment, the beds were comfortable, and the golf cart was a huge hit! Beach access was an easy walk across the street with a lovely boardwalk to the beach. Great location, close to all of the fun shops and restaurants. We all loved the Saturday after Thanksgiving parade! We received plenty of communication from Alex which was helpful. 10 out of 10.
